sentence_stem: It was not the cost that worried the team, but
correct_completion: the lack of time to finish the project.
full_sentence: It was not the cost that worried the team, but the lack of time to finish the project.
acceptable_variants: the tight deadline set by the client.
the risk of losing the contract.

options.text: so the team bought more equipment.
options.why_wrong: This is a result clause introduced by 'so', which does not complete the contrast set up by 'not... but'.

options.text: they were worried about the cost.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the idea that the stem has already rejected, so it does not create a contrast.

options.text: the lack of time to finish the project.

options.why_wrong: 'Although' starts a concessive clause, which does not give the noun phrase that the 'not... but' structure requires.

grammar_focus: Cleft-style contrast with 'It was not... that... but'
explanation: The structure 'It was not X that... but Y' contrasts a rejected cause with the real one. After 'but' we need a noun phrase that names the true focus, not a clause or a repeated idea.
translation: No fue el costo lo que preocupó al equipo, sino la falta de tiempo para terminar el proyecto.
